# dsp-citrinet: NeMo Citrinet-256 CTC speech-to-text on DSP 25. Standalone (no C2C link).
# Build (Spike):  make build CHIP=dsp25 PLATFORM=SIMS TARGET=dsp-citrinet EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS="-DLINKER=llm"
# Build (mic):    make build CHIP=dsp25 PLATFORM=CHIP TARGET=dsp-citrinet EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS="-DLINKER=llm -DDSP_CITRINET_USE_MIC=ON"
#
# Weights / golden / vocab are regenerated by dsp25-tests/citrinet-test/scripts/:
#   export_citrinet.py         -> model/citrinet_256_q80.bin   ("cn01" Q8_0 blob, BatchNorm folded)
#   dump_citrinet_reference.py -> include/citrinet_reference.h (per-stage golden, read FROM the blob)
#   gen_citrinet_tokenizer.py  -> include/citrinet_vocab.h     (1024 SentencePiece pieces)
#
# NOTE the LINKER=llm requirement: the 11.8 MB model lives in .rodata and the encoder wants a few MB
# of heap, while the stock dsp25.ld gives only a 1 MB heap. The top-level Makefile does NOT forward
# LINKER=, so it has to go inside EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS.

add_executable(dsp-citrinet
  src/main.c
  src/citrinet.c
  src/model_data.S
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bmark-lib/simple_setup.c   # init_test / PLL setup (used by the mic mode)
)

# Run modes (mutually exclusive; default = validate against the golden).
option(DSP_CITRINET_USE_MIC "Capture live I2S mic audio and transcribe in a loop" OFF)
option(DSP_CITRINET_FROM_AUDIO "Transcribe the embedded audio blob without comparing" OFF)
set(_CN_MIC 0)
set(_CN_FROM 0)
if(DSP_CITRINET_USE_MIC)
  set(_CN_MIC 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: DSP_CITRINET_USE_MIC=1 (silicon only — Spike has no I2S)")
endif()
if(DSP_CITRINET_FROM_AUDIO)
  set(_CN_FROM 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: DSP_CITRINET_FROM_AUDIO=1")
endif()
if(DSP_CITRINET_USE_MIC AND DSP_CITRINET_FROM_AUDIO)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "dsp-citrinet: USE_MIC and FROM_AUDIO are mutually exclusive")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE
  DSP_CITRINET_USE_MIC=${_CN_MIC}
  DSP_CITRINET_FROM_AUDIO=${_CN_FROM})

# PLL target frequency for PLATFORM=CHIP builds. init_test() programs the PLL to
# (freq / SYS_CLK_FREQ) x 50 MHz and sets the UART divisor from it, so this one value drives both
# the clock and the console. It also feeds the engine's cycles->ms conversion, so the two can't
# drift apart.
set(DSP_CITRINET_TARGET_FREQ_HZ 750000000 CACHE STRING "PLL target frequency in Hz (silicon builds)")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE
  DSP_CITRINET_TARGET_FREQ_HZ=${DSP_CITRINET_TARGET_FREQ_HZ}ULL
  CN_TARGET_FREQ_HZ=${DSP_CITRINET_TARGET_FREQ_HZ}ULL)
message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: DSP_CITRINET_TARGET_FREQ_HZ=${DSP_CITRINET_TARGET_FREQ_HZ}")

# Dump every parsed block descriptor at load time. Cheap (23 lines) and the fastest way to tell a
# bad blob / bad load apart from a bad computation when something only fails on silicon.
option(CITRINET_DEBUG_GEOM "Print the parsed block descriptor table" OFF)
set(_CN_GEOM 0)
if(CITRINET_DEBUG_GEOM)
  set(_CN_GEOM 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_DEBUG_GEOM=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_DEBUG_GEOM=${_CN_GEOM})

# Localize a divergence inside one block: print a fingerprint after every op (dw/pw/relu/se/res).
# -1 = off. dump_citrinet_reference.py --trace-block N emits the matching golden.
set(CITRINET_TRACE_BLOCK -1 CACHE STRING "Print per-op fingerprints for this block index (-1 = off)")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_TRACE_BLOCK=${CITRINET_TRACE_BLOCK})

# Run the encoder twice on identical input and diff the fingerprints. Separates "the hardware is
# flaky" from "the hardware is deterministically different from Spike".
option(CITRINET_DETERMINISM_CHECK "Run the encoder twice and compare" OFF)
set(_CN_DET 0)
if(CITRINET_DETERMINISM_CHECK)
  set(_CN_DET 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_DETERMINISM_CHECK=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_DETERMINISM_CHECK=${_CN_DET})

# RVV kernels for the pointwise + residual 1x1 (94% of scalar runtime on silicon). Vectorized over
# the TIME axis, so each output's accumulation order over input channels is unchanged and results
# are bit-identical to scalar — the golden stays an exact test.
option(CITRINET_USE_RVV "Use RVV kernels for pointwise/residual" OFF)
set(_CN_RVV 0)
if(CITRINET_USE_RVV)
  set(_CN_RVV 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_USE_RVV=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_USE_RVV=${_CN_RVV})

# Activation tile width (in t elements) for the RVV pointwise/residual. The kernels re-stream the
# activation buffer once per output-row block; tiling t keeps one slice resident across all rows.
# Measured cost model on this chip: ~4.5 cycles per byte of activation loaded, so traffic is what
# matters. Keep it a multiple of the vector length (32 at VLEN=256). Bigger = less weight
# re-streaming but a larger resident slice: at Ci=Co=256, 32 -> ~137 KB working set, 64 -> ~201 KB
# against a 256 KB cache. Tunable so it can be swept on silicon without a source edit.
set(CITRINET_TILE_T 32 CACHE STRING "Activation t-tile for the RVV kernels (multiple of VL)")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_TILE_T=${CITRINET_TILE_T})
message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_TILE_T=${CITRINET_TILE_T}")

# 6-row register blocking in the pointwise. MEASURED SLOWER on silicon (4609 -> 4721 ms): 1.5x fewer
# activation loads, but 13 concurrent memory streams instead of 9. Kept so the result is
# reproducible; do not turn this on expecting a win.
option(CITRINET_MR6 "Pointwise 6-row register blocking (measured slower — see citrinet.c)" OFF)
set(_CN_MR6 0)
if(CITRINET_MR6)
  set(_CN_MR6 1)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_MR6=${_CN_MR6})

# Pack the activation tile into [c][t] order once per tile so the pointwise inner loop reads a
# contiguous stream instead of striding T*4 bytes per input channel (600 B at T=150, 64 passes per
# tile). Costs one extra read+write of the tile. This is a "restructured, not eliminated" change —
# the category that lost with MR=6 — so measure it, do not assume.
option(CITRINET_PACK "Pack the activation tile for contiguous pointwise loads" OFF)
set(_CN_PACK 0)
if(CITRINET_PACK)
  set(_CN_PACK 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_PACK=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_PACK=${_CN_PACK})

# Boot-time probe of the DMA strided gather (DRAM -> 64 KB scratchpad at 0x08000000) that weight/
# activation staging would depend on. Verified and timed; the DMA wait is bounded so a wedge reports.
option(CITRINET_DMA_PROBE "Probe the DMA strided gather into the scratchpad at boot" OFF)
set(_CN_DMAP 0)
if(CITRINET_DMA_PROBE)
  set(_CN_DMAP 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_DMA_PROBE=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_DMA_PROBE=${_CN_DMAP})

# Stage pointwise weight chunks into the 64 KB scratchpad at 0x08000000 via DMA, double-buffered, so
# the weight stream stops passing through (and evicting) the data cache. Contiguous transfers only
# (logw=6) — the strided gather was probed on silicon and corrupts. Spike has no DMA engine, so the
# staged path CANNOT be validated in simulation: the on-chip STAGES/TOKENS check against the golden
# is the correctness oracle. With this OFF the kernel is byte-for-byte the proven path.
option(CITRINET_DMA_STAGE "DMA-stage pointwise weights into the scratchpad" OFF)
set(_CN_DMAS 0)
if(CITRINET_DMA_STAGE)
  set(_CN_DMAS 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_DMA_STAGE=1 (silicon-only correctness check)")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_DMA_STAGE=${_CN_DMAS})

# Bound on the DMA idle spin, so a wedged transfer reports instead of hanging the core.
set(CITRINET_DMA_WAIT_SPIN 100000 CACHE STRING "dma_wait_till_inactive idle-cycle bound")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_DMA_WAIT_SPIN=${CITRINET_DMA_WAIT_SPIN})

# Run the depthwise on the CONV1D accelerator (MMIO FIFO at 0x08800000) instead of the RVV kernel.
# The depthwise is the worst kernel here (31 cycles/MAC vs 2.9 for the pointwise) because it re-reads
# each input row k times; the engine streams each element once. NOT parallelism — the core hand-feeds
# the FIFO — and the Amdahl ceiling is ~15% since only the depthwise can be expressed as a 1D conv.
# NOT bit-identical either: the engine's FP32 accumulation order differs, so the stage fingerprints
# shift slightly and the 2% golden tolerance becomes the correctness gate.
option(CITRINET_CONV1D "Run the depthwise on the CONV1D accelerator" OFF)
set(_CN_C1D 0)
if(CITRINET_CONV1D)
  set(_CN_C1D 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_CONV1D=1 (depthwise on the accelerator)")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_CONV1D=${_CN_C1D})

# 0 = leave scratch buffers as malloc returned them, 1 = zero-fill, 2 = NaN poison.
# Spike gives zeroed fresh memory, silicon gives the previous run's leftovers — so an uninitialized
# read passes on Spike forever and fails intermittently on silicon. 2 makes it impossible to miss.
set(CITRINET_POISON 0 CACHE STRING "Scratch-buffer fill: 0=none 1=zero 2=NaN")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_POISON=${CITRINET_POISON})

# Standalone DRAM write/read-back test at boot, in MB (0 = off). Independent of the model.
set(CITRINET_MEMTEST_MB 0 CACHE STRING "DRAM write/read-back test size in MB at boot (0 = off)")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_MEMTEST_MB=${CITRINET_MEMTEST_MB})

# Re-fingerprint each block's output after forcing it out of cache. Catches activations that do not
# survive eviction — invisible to the sequential MEMTEST.
option(CITRINET_EVICT_CHECK "Verify block outputs survive cache eviction" OFF)
set(_CN_EV 0)
if(CITRINET_EVICT_CHECK)
  set(_CN_EV 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_EVICT_CHECK=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_EVICT_CHECK=${_CN_EV})

# Per-kernel cycle counters (frontend / depthwise / pointwise / SE / residual / decoder).
option(CITRINET_PROFILE "Per-kernel cycle profile" OFF)
set(_CN_PROF 0)
if(CITRINET_PROFILE)
  set(_CN_PROF 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_PROFILE=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_PROFILE=${_CN_PROF})

# model_data.S resolves "model/*.bin" relative to the demo dir.
#
# OBJECT_DEPENDS is REQUIRED, not a nicety: the compiler emits no depfile for `.incbin`, so without
# it a regenerated model does NOT rebuild this object and the ELF keeps the OLD weights. Verified:
# `touch`ing the .bin left model_data.S.obj untouched. That silently produces an ELF whose blob and
# whose golden disagree — which looks exactly like a flaky chip.
set_source_files_properties(src/model_data.S PROPERTIES
  COMPILE_OPTIONS "-I${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  OBJECT_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/model/citrinet_256_q80.bin;${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/model/citrinet_audio.bin")

# Optimization level. The top-level CMakeLists does a global add_compile_options(-O1) which lands
# AFTER Release's -O3, so the whole project otherwise builds at -O1 (last -O wins). Target options
# come after directory options, so this wins. Same fix as dsp-moonshine.
set(CITRINET_OPT "-O3" CACHE STRING "Optimization level for dsp-citrinet (overrides the global -O1)")
target_compile_options(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE ${CITRINET_OPT})
message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_OPT=${CITRINET_OPT}")

# STACK SIZE — this was the port's most expensive omission. The linker default is 4 KiB, but
# cn_run_validate's frame alone was 18,800 bytes (it held a 17,272-byte cn_model_t as a LOCAL), so
# every silicon run smashed ~16 KiB past the bottom of the stack. Spike maps 2 GiB of zeroed RAM at
# 0x80000000, so the overflow landed on real unused memory there and the test passed forever; on
# silicon that address is outside the 256 MiB the stock dsp25.ld declares, so stack locals did not
# reliably read back what was written -> the same ELF produced different results on different runs.
# The big locals are static now (see cn_run_validate), but keep the sibling ports' 64 KiB anyway:
# newlib's %e/%f formatting (_dtoa_r) alone can want >1 KiB, and 4 KiB has no margin for anything.
# STACK PLACEMENT — the second half of the same bug, and the more important half.
#
# dsp25-llm.ld declares DRAM as 2 GiB so a big .incbin'd model fits in medany's +-2 GiB PC-relative
# range, then derives the stack from the TOP of that region: __stack_start = ORIGIN + LENGTH -
# 5*__stack_size. But the chip's DRAM really ends at 0x8FFFFFFF (stock dsp25.ld says 256 MiB), so
# that puts the stack ~1.9 GB past the end of memory, in address space that is only PARTIALLY
# backed. Measured on silicon:
#   __stack_start=0xFFFFB000 (4 KiB)   -> frames ran off the bottom; stores did not stick  (flaky)
#   __stack_start=0xFFFB0000 (64 KiB)  -> works, but reads below ~0xFFFB3900 return garbage
#   __stack_start=0xFFEC0000 (256 KiB) -> writing there HANGS THE CORE outright
# So the usable window is a narrow, undocumented band near the top of the 32-bit space, and "make
# the stack bigger" walks straight off the bottom of it.
#
# Fix: pin the stack into REAL DRAM instead of inheriting it from the fictitious region end. These
# are PROVIDE()d in the linker script, so --defsym overrides them. 0x8FE00000 + 5 harts * 256 KiB
# = 0x8FF40000, leaving 768 KiB of cushion below the 0x90000000 DRAM top — the same placement the
# stock dsp25.ld uses, just with a bigger stack. __heap_end moves with it so sbrk cannot grow the
# heap into the stacks.
#
# NOTE for other demos: dsp-moonshine, dsp-whisper and the tinyllama target all use LINKER=llm with
# 64 KiB stacks and are therefore still sitting in that fragile window. They work today; they are
# one stack-size change away from not working.
set(CITRINET_STACK_BASE 0x8FE00000 CACHE STRING "Stack base in real DRAM (see comment above)")
target_link_options(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE
  -Wl,--defsym=__stack_size=0x40000               # 256 KiB per hart
  -Wl,--defsym=__stack_start=${CITRINET_STACK_BASE}
  -Wl,--defsym=__heap_end=${CITRINET_STACK_BASE}  # sbrk stops below the stacks
)

# Catch the next oversized frame at BUILD time rather than as a flaky chip. Every frame here is now
# a few hundred bytes; 8 KiB is far above that and far below the 64 KiB stack.
# 16 KB: the pointwise stages MR x CI_MAX dequantized weights (10 KB) in its frame. Still ~6% of the
# 256 KB stack, and far below anything that could run off the end.
target_compile_options(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE -Wstack-usage=16384)

# Dual-core: split pointwise/residual output rows and depthwise channels across both harts. Each
# hart has its OWN vector unit, so both halves vectorize at full rate. Uses thread-lib's hthread
# runtime with the ordering proven in bearly25-bmarks/rvv-matmul and c2c-demos/dsp-whisper:
# init_test -> hthread_init -> a nop warm-up dispatch. hthread.c supplies __main for hart 1, so
# citrinet.c must NOT define its own (it would park hart 1 and hang every join).
option(CITRINET_DUALCORE "Split the hot kernels across both harts" OFF)
set(_CN_DC 0)
if(CITRINET_DUALCORE)
  set(_CN_DC 1)
  # Compile hthread.c straight in rather than linking the `threadlib` target: that target only
  # exists when the top-level THREAD_LIB option is ON, and dsp-whisper already does it this way.
  # BEFORE is REQUIRED on the include path — bmark-lib also ships an hthread.h, with N_HARTS=4 and
  # no hthread_init at all, and picking that one up silently breaks hart bring-up.
  target_sources(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/thread-lib/hthread.c)
  target_include_directories(dsp-citrinet BEFORE PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/thread-lib)
  message(STATUS "dsp-citrinet: CITRINET_DUALCORE=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_DUALCORE=${_CN_DC})

# Percent of rows hart 0 keeps. hart 0 also pays issue/join overhead, so 50 is a starting point,
# not a known optimum (rvv-matmul uses 55/45). Sweep it on silicon.
set(CITRINET_MC_SPLIT_PCT 50 CACHE STRING "Percent of rows hart 0 keeps in dual-core mode")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE CN_MC_SPLIT_PCT=${CITRINET_MC_SPLIT_PCT})

target_include_directories(dsp-citrinet PUBLIC include)
target_include_directories(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bmark-lib)

# glossy (whole-archive) provides the dsp25 HAL (UART etc.); m provides cosf/sinf/expf/logf/sqrtf.
target_link_libraries(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE
  -L${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/glossy -Wl,--whole-archive glossy -Wl,--no-whole-archive
  m
)

if(PROF_COV)
  target_link_libraries(dsp-citrinet PRIVATE gcov)
endif()
